description: Draft a reply, in the user's trained voice, to an inbound comment or message on one of their posts. The draft is saved as pending for review (list_persona_replies) — nothing is sent. Needs a plan with PersonaForge replies.

inbound_text.description: The comment or message to reply to (max 2000 characters).

source_post_id.description: Platform id of the user's post being replied under.

name: generate_persona_reply
